NOTICE OF WAIVER OF ORAL ARGUMENT AND REQUEST FOR SUBMISSION
ON THE PAPERS
Plaintiff gives notice that he waives oral argument on Plaintiff's Rule 72(a) Objections to
ECF No. 96 and Motion to Set Aside or Modify That Order, Determine Reassignment Authority,
and Grant Leave to Supplement ECF No. 93, and requests that the Court direct submission of that
Motion without oral argument under Local Civil Rules 7(E) and 7(J) and Federal Rule of Civil
Procedure 78(b), or set such hearing arrangement as the Court directs.
This Notice applies only to the Motion identified above. It does not withdraw any objection
stated in ECF Nos. 66 or 67 to provisions of ECF Nos. 63 or 65, and it does not alter the submission
of any other pending motion.
